finalText:
Found it. `src/core/settings.js` referenced a variable `retries` that was never defined — it should have read `env.retries` from the caller's config. That threw during the link stage and killed the build every time.

I fixed the line to `maxRetries: env.retries`. The build now finishes clean: exit code 0, "3 warnings, 0 errors."

The 3 warnings still there are just noise (a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export, and a circular import) — none of them break anything, so I left those alone unless you want them cleaned up too.
